description.zh:
分类ID。可通过以下方式获取：
- 登录[点播控制台](https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择**配置管理** > **媒资管理配置** > **分类管理**查看分类ID。
- 通过[创建分类](~~56401~~)接口创建分类时，分类ID为返回参数CateId的值。
- 通过[获取分类及子分类](~~56406~~)接口查询分类时，为请求后返回参数CateId的值。
description.en:
The category ID. Obtain the ID in one of the following ways:

- Log on to the [VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose **Configuration Management** > **Media Management** > **Categories** to view the category ID.

- The value of the CateId parameter that is returned after you call the [AddCategory](~~56401~~) operation.

- The value of the CateId parameter that is returned after you call the [GetCategories](~~56406~~) operation.

description.zh: CreationTime的结束时间，需晚于开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The end of the time range to query based on the creation time. The end time must be later than the start time. The time is in UTC. The format is *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z.
The page number. The default value is **1**.

description.zh: 列表页大小。默认值为**10**，最大值为**100**。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is **10**. The maximum value is **100**.

description.zh: 自定义 ID 列表。由一个或多个自定义 ID 组成，多个 ID 之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。最多支持 20 个。
description.en: A list of one or more custom IDs. Separate multiple IDs with a comma (,). You can specify up to 20 IDs.

description.zh:
查询结果排序。取值：

- **CreationTime:Desc**（默认值）：按创建时间倒序。
- **CreationTime:Asc**：按创建时间升序。
description.en:
The sorting rule for the query results. Valid values:

- **CreationTime:Desc** (default): Sorts the results by creation time in descending order.

- **CreationTime:Asc**: Sorts the results by creation time in ascending order.

description.zh: CreationTime（创建时间）的开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query based on the creation time. The time is in UTC. The format is *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z.

description.zh:
视频状态。支持获取多个状态的视频，多个状态之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：

- **Uploading**：上传中。
- **UploadFail**：上传失败。
- **UploadSucc**：上传完成。
- **Transcoding**：转码中。
- **TranscodeFail**：转码失败。
- **Checking**：审核中。
- **Blocked**：屏蔽。
- **Normal**：正常。
- **ProduceFail**：合成失败。

各视频状态的具体含义解释及相关限制，请参见[Status：视频状态](~~52839#section-p7c-jgy-070~~)。
description.en:
The status of the video. To retrieve videos in multiple statuses, separate the statuses with a comma (,). Valid values:

- **Uploading**: The video is being uploaded.

- **UploadFail**: The video failed to be uploaded.

- **UploadSucc**: The video is uploaded.

- **Transcoding**: The video is being transcoded.

- **TranscodeFail**: The video failed to be transcoded.

- **Checking**: The video is being reviewed.

- **Blocked**: The video is blocked.

- **Normal**: The video is in a normal state.

- **ProduceFail**: The video failed to be produced.

For more information about each video status and its limits, see [Status: Video status](~~52839#section-p7c-jgy-070~~).
The storage address of the audio or video file.

descriptions.zh: 本接口最多可获取指定筛选条件（如视频状态、分类ID等）的前**5000**条音视频。建议限定StartTime和EndTime来分批获取数据。若需要查询更多音视频，甚至遍历所有音视频信息，请参见[搜索媒体信息](~~86044~~)。
descriptions.en: This operation retrieves up to **5000** media files based on filter conditions, such as video status or category ID. To retrieve data in batches, specify the StartTime and EndTime parameters. To query more files or traverse all media asset information, see [SearchMedia](~~86044~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vod get-video-list --cate-id 781111 --status Uploading,Normal --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --sort-by CreationTime:Asc --start-time 2017-01-11T12:00:00Z --end-time 2017-01-11T12:59:00Z --storage-location out-0000.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com --reference-ids 123-123,1234-1234 --region cn-hangzhou
